messages:
jocelyn (partnerships): Quick idea — instead of one monolithic committed SKU, what if we ship 'dynamic SKU tiling' in the marketplace to nudge renewals? small nested SKUs that can be converted into longer-term SKUs with a time-limited rebate/credit.
rahul (product): Love that. It gives customers a lower-friction onramp and a clear path to convert. Can we attach SI co-sell credits on conversion to accelerate adoption?
eva (sales): Sales question — how would this look in the marketplace UI? we need super-clear naming and a tooltip: "convert & keep credits" or similar.
tomas (finance): From finance: we need a simple model. three tiles = starter (metered), mid (6mo reserve), convertable-annual. Model scenarios with 0/30/60% conversion to annual and cap rebate at 20% to preserve margin.
nina (legal): Legal flag — rebates + credits can trigger reseller/marketplace conflicts. We need a private-offer clause and a clear customer consent checkbox for the conversion rebate.
jocelyn (partnerships): Proposal sketch: create 3 marketplace SKUs (tile.small, tile.mid, tile.convertable) with metadata: {convertible: true, conversion_window_days: 60, rebate_pct: X}. Conversion issues generate a single-use voucher tied to customer id. SI crediting = separate ledger entry on conversion.
rahul (product): Example of naming/offer payload for listings team (very rough):
```
{"sku":"tile.convertable","title":"Starter -> Annual (convertible)","private_offer_terms":"convert within 60 days for rebate","metadata":{"convertible":"true","rebate_pct":"12","si_credit":"eligible"}}
```
eva (sales): Suggested pitch: "Lock price today, convert later — receive up to 12% rebate when you convert to annual within 60 days." Short, customer-facing.
tomas (finance): Pilot ask: run 90-day pilot on 10 mid-market accounts. KPIs: conversion rate to annual within 60 days, incremental ARR, effective rebate burn. Finance will simulate P&L with conservative conversion at 15%.
jocelyn (partnerships): Operational next steps: engineering adds SKU flags + conversion API hook; partnerships builds SI credit mapping; listings team approves copy + tooltip; growth picks pilot cohort.
nina (legal): Legal sign-off for pilot if: (1) rebate <= 20%, (2) single-use conversion voucher, (3) explicit checkbox, (4) private-offer clause referencing this program.
release-bot: Reminder — marketplace listing schema changes require a 7-day review window and a security scan for billing integrations.
eva (sales): I'll own pilot outreach + case selection. @tomas can you approve the finance deck by EOD tomorrow?
tomas (finance): Yes — I'll drop the deck into the partnerships folder by 5pm.
jocelyn (partnerships): Great. I'll draft a short program doc & tracking board and loop eng/product. Thanks team :rocket:
